note: The `*_initialized_prefix_len` and `*_read_bytes` fields are semantic views over the same vulnerable-version scalar at each event point: Stage 04 measures how many bytes of the concrete source expression are initialized with `__msan_test_shadow`, and records the exact source-level read width of that same scalar as the compared `*_read_bytes` value. The root-cause allocation at `wolfSSL_HMAC_CTX_new()` leaves this same `src->hmac.macType`/`src->macType` field undefined until a later initializer runs; the required assertion re-observes those bytes at the first common copy site shared by the vulnerable and fixed executions.
